signal: Prove raised $40M led by MassMutual Ventures and Capital One Ventures and launched ProveX, a digital trust exchange.

email.body1:
Kevin, saw Prove closed $40M from MassMutual and Capital One Ventures and shipped ProveX right after.

New capital plus a new product usually means more in-market accounts surfacing than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns buying signals into booked meetings with zero rep time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Prove.

Most RevOps teams have the signals but lose days getting them researched, written, and into a rep's hands, so the in-market window closes before anyone reaches out. The lift comes from collapsing that latency, not cleaner dashboards, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, live in four weeks with every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage fintechs. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If turning signals into meetings faster isn't a RevOps priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise the roadmap fills up fast, and I know how that goes.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a pipeline gap analysis scoped to Prove's motion? I will tailor it to your team either way.
